title: CWP/30440/2024 of AMIT KUMAR AND OTHERS Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 119 Date of Decision: 18.02.2025 Amit Kumar and others ......Petitioner(s) Versus State of Haryana and others .....Respondent(s) CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JAGMOHAN BANSAL Present: Ms. Sukriti Kaur, Advocate, for the petitioners. Ms. Rajni Gupta, Addl. A.G., Haryana. Mr. Prince Singh, Advocate, for respondent No.2. JAGMOHAN BANSAL, J. (Oral)

1. The petitioners through instant petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India are seeking direction to respondent to give them joining letter alongwith notional benefits.

2. Learned counsel for respondent No.2 submits that as per instructions dated 20.01.1988 issued by Chief Secretary of Haryana, the waiting list cannot remain in force for a period beyond one year. In the instant case, the selection process concluded on 16.01.2024, thus, waiting list became inoperative on 15.01.2024. Nevertheless, the respondent has requested Chief Secretary to grant permission to operate waiting list beyond one year. If the permission is accorded by Chief Secretary, the competent authority would consider claim of the petitioners in accordance with law.

3. Ms. Sukriti Kaur, learned counsel for the petitioners agrees to the aforesaid arrangement.

4. In the wake of statement of both sides, instant petition stands disposed of. Let the needful be done expeditiously. 18.02.2025 (JAGMOHAN BANSAL) shivani JUDGE Shivani Gupta
